questions.lead: On 19 October, voters in the province of Alberta answered ten referendum questions. One asked whether the province should begin the legal process towards a binding vote on separation.
questions.prompt: What share of voters supported Alberta staying where it is?

questions.lead: Alberta's referendum asked whether the province should stay where it is, or start the legal process towards a binding vote on separating.
questions.prompt: Which country would Alberta have been seeking to separate from?

questions.lead: Ron Wallace, a grower in Rhode Island, has raised the first pumpkin to surpass 3,000 pounds, the largest fruit on record.
questions.prompt: How much did his record pumpkin weigh?

questions.lead: Japan's space agency has launched a spacecraft from the Tanegashima Space Center towards Phobos, one of the two moons of Mars. The plan is to land there, gather material and bring it home.
questions.prompt: How much surface material is the mission aiming to collect?

questions.lead: Before the spacecraft lands, it is due to set a small rover down on the surface of Phobos in 2029 to scout a landing and sampling site.
questions.prompt: What is the name of that rover?

explanations: More than three-quarters of voters supported the province remaining in Canada. The question was one of ten put to Albertans on 19 October 2026.
Alberta would have been separating from Canada. Voters rejected pursuing a future independence referendum.
The pumpkin weighed 3,156 pounds. The previous record, a pumpkin of nearly 2,857 pounds, had been set a week earlier by the British grower Ian Paton.
The mission aims to collect at least 10 grams of surface material. The samples are due to reach Earth in 2031.
The rover is called Idefix. It is to be delivered to the surface of Phobos in 2029 to help identify a landing and sampling site.

sources.excerpt: Albertan voters reject pursuing a future independence referendum, with more than three-quarters supporting the province remaining in Canada.
The independence question of the 2026 Alberta referendum is one of 10 questions of the 2026 Alberta referendums, which took place on October 19, 2026.
The question was a choice of two options: whether to remain in Canada or for the province of Alberta to take steps toward holding a binding referendum on separating from Canada.
On October 10, Ron Wallace took the pumpkin king crown with a 3,156-pounder. The previous record—a respectable, nearly 2,857-pound pumpkin—was set just a week earlier by British grower Ian Paton
A Rhode Island Man Grew the First Pumpkin to Surpass 3,000 Pounds. The Gargantuan Gourd Is the Largest Fruit Ever

JAXA launches the Martian Moons eXploration spacecraft from the Tanegashima Space Center toward Phobos aboard an H3 rocket, aiming to collect at least 10 grams of surface material from the Martian moon and return the samples to Earth in 2031.
It will deliver the rover Idefix to the surface of Phobos in 2029, which among other missions will identify a suitable landing and sampling site for MMX.
